mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 6.0% over three months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 6.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns through a non-additive interaction effect over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or joint signal fails to predict positive returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0% annually) indicates the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase above 1100 thousand units signals a strengthening housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST > 1100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market tightness that increases household income and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns through an interaction effect over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or joint signal fails to predict positive returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth above 2.5%) indicates economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
